## Goal
- Audit, repair, and verify QA/deployment status for all claimed IVX production work under `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`, without falsely certifying incomplete items.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Use only canonical repository `https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`.
- Do not create repositories, forks, duplicate projects, or temporary branches unless explicitly approved.
- Do not expose credentials, OTPs, passwords, bearer tokens, or personal test identities.
- Do not claim ownership, deployment, or QA completion without verifiable evidence.
- User requested immediate QA audit and completion of outstanding verification.

## Progress
### Done
- Verified canonical GitHub repository:
  ```text
  full_name=ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
  private=true
  owner.login=ibb142
  owner.type=User
  default_branch=main
  ```
- Authenticated GitHub permissions previously reported:
  ```json
  {"admin":true,"maintain":true,"push":true,"triage":true,"pull":true}
  ```
- Verified canonical GitHub `main` head and production parity:
  ```text
  012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  fix(android): isolate disposable QA signing and launch QA package
  ```
- Verified production at `https://api.ivxholding.com`:
  ```text
  service=ivx-owner-ai-backend
  environment=production
  commit=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  commitShort=012bb088
  renderServiceId=srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
  status=healthy
  ```
- Verified live endpoints:
  ```text
  https://api.ivxholding.com/health HTTP 200
  https://api.ivxholding.com/version HTTP 200
  https://ivxholding.com HTTP 200
  https://chat.ivxholding.com HTTP 200
  ```
- Verified production runtime deployment capabilities/configuration:
  ```text
  credentials.GITHUB_REPO_URL=true
  credentials.GITHUB_TOKEN=true
  credentials.RENDER_API_KEY=true
  credentials.RENDER_SERVICE_ID=true
  github.canReadRepo=true
  github.canPush=true
  render.canDeploy=true
  executionPath=github_git_data_api
  renderEnvSafeMerge=true
  deploymentDeduplication=true
  liveWorkPersistence=true
  ```
- Verified security/CORS basics:
  ```text
  x-content-type-options: nosniff
  x-frame-options: DENY
  OPTIONS /api/members/phone/send-code HTTP 204
  access-control-allow-origin: https://ivxholding.com
  ```
- Targeted registration QA passed:
  ```text
  bun test backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts
  13 pass
  0 fail
  45 expect() calls
  ```
- Live invalid-registration behavior safely returns:
  ```json
  {"ok":false,"stage":"VALIDATING","message":"First name and last name are required.","code":"INVALID_EMAIL"}
  ```
- Confirmed `git log --oneline -n 55 | wc -l` represents 55 displayed recent commits, not 55 unverified pending production tasks.
- Confirmed plaintext fallback OTP persistence remains:
  ```ts
  interface FallbackCodeRecord {
    userId: string;
    type: 'email' | 'phone';
    code: string;
  }
  ```
- Confirmed local Git submodule mapping:
  ```text
  .gitmodules
  path = ivx-holdings-platform
  url = https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform.git
  branch = main
  ```
- GitHub Sync was not created because the canonical source path already exists:
  ```text
  GitHub Sync source path already exists: ivx-holdings-platform. Choose a different path or remove the existing path before connecting.
  ```
- Canonical `main` branch protection is enabled with one required approving review and admin enforcement; no required status checks are configured.

### In Progress
- Inspecting canonical workflow definitions in `.github/workflows/ivx-ci.yml`.
- Determining precise causes of canonical CI failures/skips before making repair changes.
- Preparing an evidence-based certification rather than treating “55 tasks” as a deployable unit.

### Blocked
- Current attempts to download canonical GitHub Actions job logs fail:
  ```text
  curl: (22) The requested URL returned error: 401
  ```
- Render account-level ownership, billing ownership, and human administrator membership were not directly verified through the Render API/dashboard.
- Supabase project ownership, billing ownership, organization membership, domains, and environment-variable control were not directly verified.
- A direct Render API deploy attempt returned:
  ```text
  curl: (22) The requested URL returned error: 401
  ```
- Owner deployment action requires an authenticated Supabase owner session:
  ```text
  IVX auth guard failed: invalid or expired Supabase session.
  ```
- Full workspace typecheck currently fails due to missing/unresolved Expo/TypeScript dependencies/configuration:
  ```text
  error TS2688: Cannot find type definition file for 'node'.
  error TS2307: Cannot find module 'expo/config' or its corresponding type declarations.
  error TS2307: Cannot find module 'expo-router' or its corresponding type declarations.
  error TS17004: Cannot use JSX unless the '--jsx' flag is provided.
  ```
- Canonical-main GitHub Actions include failures/skips for SHA `012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c`:
  ```text
  Android release consistency: failure
  Android release APK: skipped
  Playwright E2E (web surface): skipped
  ```
- Earlier canonical run evidence also identified:
  ```text
  IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline: failure
  Android Emulator QA: failure
  Lint: failure
  TypeScript typecheck: failure
  ```
- Android release consistency failed at:
  ```text
  Validate configured APK release references
  ```

## Key Decisions
- Treat `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` as the sole canonical source of truth.
- Treat production backend deployment as verified live because canonical GitHub `main` and production report exact SHA parity.
- Do not certify all “55 tasks” as complete: the number is a recent commit display count, not a verified task inventory or a passing release gate.
- Do not claim complete end-to-end owner control until Render and Supabase account-level ownership are verified in user-controlled dashboards.
- Do not make production mutations until reproducible canonical CI failures are understood and repaired.
- Preserve plaintext OTP fallback storage as an open security defect requiring remediation.

## Next Steps
- 1. Restore an authenticated GitHub token/session with GitHub Actions log-read access for `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`.
- 2. Retrieve failure logs for Android release consistency, lint, typecheck, E2E, Android emulator, iOS simulator, and QA Suite runs on `012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c`.
- 3. Repair reproducible workflow, dependency, typecheck, and Android APK release-reference failures in canonical source.
- 4. Run clean canonical CI, backend tests, mobile typecheck/build, Android release validation, and applicable E2E checks.
- 5. Add required GitHub status checks to protected `main` after identifying the intended mandatory workflows.
- 6. Verify Render dashboard account owner, members, service ownership, billing, deploy hooks, and environment-variable access.
- 7. Verify Supabase project owner, organization members, billing, Auth configuration, database access, domains, and environment-variable access.
- 8. Replace plaintext `FallbackCodeRecord.code` persistence with hashed verification-code storage.
- 9. Commit, push, deploy, and re-verify production SHA parity only after all required QA gates pass.
- 10. Publish a per-task/task-inventory certification only after a definitive list of the claimed 55 tasks is supplied or derived from an authoritative tracker.

## Critical Context
- GitHub repository control is verified for `ibb142`; canonical `main` is:
  ```text
  012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  ```
- Production is live and SHA-matched to canonical `main`:
  ```text
  GitHub main=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  production health/version=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  ```
- Production boot time at audit:
  ```text
  2026-08-03T11:49:24.393Z
  ```
- Screenshot evidence supplied by user shows Render deployment live for `012bb08` at `https://api.ivxholding.com`.
- GitHub repository tree audit returned:
  ```text
  truncated=false
  blob_count=2332
  tree_count=240
  ```
- Canonical branch protection currently has:
  ```text
  required_status_checks=null
  required_approving_review_count=1
  enforce_admins.enabled=true
  allow_force_pushes.enabled=false
  allow_deletions.enabled=false
  ```
- Latest release artifact is explicitly QA-only:
  ```text
  tag=android-v1.9.4
  name=IVX Holdings 1.9.4 — QA artifact (not a production release)
  prerelease=true
  asset=ivx-holdings-1.9.4.apk
  size=84087555
  ```
- Local clone is not clean or aligned with canonical `main`:
  ```text
  /tmp/ivx-holdings-platform-canonical
  branch=fix/member-phase1-minimum-fields
  HEAD=0692b6a25ea5ca3d6b91f28fae78ba82ee92af59
  M backend/api/ivx-members.ts
  M expo/app/member-register.tsx
  M expo/lib/member-service.ts
  ```
- Do not use the local clone remote as canonical deployment evidence:
  ```text
  https://***@github.com/ibb142/IvXHOLDING-
  ```
- Existing OTP settings:
  ```text
  CODE_TTL_MINUTES = 10
  CODE_LENGTH = 6
  MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5
  ```

## Relevant Files
- `.gitmodules`: maps `ivx-holdings-platform` submodule to canonical GitHub URL and `main`.
- `.github/workflows/ivx-ci.yml`: canonical workflow containing backend, chat/intent/performance, Android release consistency, and Expo dependency steps.
- `/tmp/ivx-holdings-platform-canonical`: non-clean local clone on `fix/member-phase1-minimum-fields`; not canonical `main`.
- `backend/services/ivx-registration-orchestrator.ts`: registration orchestration; targeted test passed.
- `backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts`: 13 passing targeted registration/orchestration tests.
- `backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts`: plaintext OTP fallback storage defect; contains `FallbackCodeRecord.code`.
